Two modules for configuration files and authentication tokens.

- `yaml-to-json.wasm`: YAML config files, API specs and front matter to JSON, with anchors, merge keys and multi-document files resolved, quoted values kept as text, and oversized alias expansion refused
- `jwt-decoder.wasm`: JSON Web Tokens to header, claims and UTC dates, with expiry checks against a time the flow passes in and warnings for unsigned or non-expiring tokens. It does not verify signatures.

The other modules are unchanged. Every file is built on GitHub from the tagged source, byte-identical to a local `./build.sh`, with `SHA256SUMS` and a signed build attestation.
